tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation, for which the discovery rules require abstention rather than a stationary smooth model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot already identifies high-frequency sign oscillation, triggering scoped abstention; additional measurement is not needed.
These stationary smooth mechanisms do not resolve the observed non-stationary oscillatory behavior.
The auxiliary probe is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
